reason: We already have unit tests, Playwright end-to-end tests and CI gating every AI pull request, and nothing has slipped through badly enough to make me add another tool. Being free doesn't change that: setting up recordings and keeping them current costs time I'd rather spend writing the tests directly.
objection: Recorded scenarios break every time the UI changes on purpose, so I'd end up babysitting false diffs and re-recording, which is more work than updating a test. And the one-cent invoice demo is in their own README, so I can't tell if it catches real bugs in our app or just a staged one.
would_change_my_mind: An AI-written PR that passes our whole suite and still ships a real regression to production. After that I'd try it on that exact flow.
